boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Texas A&M library spaces for quiet work, collaboration, research, media making, and supported access.

cards.entity_name: Sterling C. Evans Library Quiet Floors
cards.title: Evans Library Quiet Floors
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library
cards.notes: Use the third or fifth floor when your work needs a quieter setting; keep calls, conversation, and speaker audio outside these areas.
cards.short_summary: Two quiet floors and individual study rooms inside Evans Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M Libraries identifies the third and fifth floors of Evans Library as quiet floors with open study space.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Spaces | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Quiet-space rules prohibit talking, cell-phone use, video chat, and speakers.

cards.entity_name: Sterling C. Evans Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Evans Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library, floors 1–4
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a collaborative session with two or more people, then use its whiteboard and, where available, wall monitor.
cards.short_summary: Library rooms configured for collaborative work in groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library has group study rooms on floors one through four; most include a table, chairs, and whiteboard.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: These rooms are intended for groups of two or more; room reservations are available through the Libraries.

cards.title: Evans Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library, first floor
cards.notes: Look for a self-contained first-floor pod when you want a compact desk-and-power setup; reserve one of the reservable pods ahead.
cards.short_summary: Three freestanding study pods on Evans Library’s first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Evans Library has three freestanding first-floor study pods with seating, desk, and power outlets; two are reservable.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Spaces | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Two of the three pods are reservable; availability can vary.

cards.title: Evans Annex Fifth-Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Evans Annex, fifth floor
cards.notes: Head to the Annex fifth floor for open quiet study and Open Access Lab computers when you need a focused library work block.
cards.short_summary: Quiet open study space with OAL computers in the Evans Annex.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M Libraries lists the fifth floor of the Evans Annex as a quiet floor with open study space and OAL computers.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Spaces | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Follow quiet-space rules; library access and operating hours can change.

cards.entity_name: West Campus Library Quiet Study Space
cards.title: West Campus Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: West Campus Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use this quiet floor for independent work with nearby Open Access Lab computers, especially when your classwork is on west campus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study floor with computers at West Campus Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M Libraries identifies West Campus Library’s third floor as a quiet floor with open study space and OAL computers.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Spaces | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Conversation, calls, video chat, and speakers are not allowed in quiet spaces.

cards.title: Kelsey Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cushing Memorial Library & Archives, second floor
cards.notes: Choose this reading room for quiet study or archival research; plan around its stated weekday hours and use headphones for electronic devices.
cards.short_summary: A 38-seat quiet room inside Cushing Memorial Library & Archives.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kelsey Reading Room is available for Cushing collection researchers and quiet study, with 38 seats and two OAL computers.
cards.source_title: Kelsey Reading Room | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The page lists standard hours of Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; check library hours for changes.

cards.title: Maker Zone
cards.subtitle: Sterling C. Evans Library
cards.notes: Bring a valid Aggie ID and try a hands-on project with the available crafting equipment; workshops and open-studio sessions are offered during semesters.
cards.short_summary: A library makerspace for sewing, cutting-machine, and craft projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Maker Zone is an experiential learning space for current Texas A&M students, faculty, and staff, with workshops and open studio times.
cards.source_title: Welcome New Students | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Valid Aggie ID is required; access is for current students, faculty, and staff affiliated with Texas A&M.

cards.title: The Studio
cards.subtitle: Evans Annex, sixth floor, Room 3.653
cards.notes: Reserve a Studio space when a project calls for audio, video, graphics, or multimedia work; the One Button Studio needs only a flash drive.
cards.short_summary: A media-production space with specialized equipment and project support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Studio provides tools and assistance for graphics, video, audio, and multimedia projects and is located in Evans Annex Room 3.653.
cards.source_title: The Studio | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve a Studio space through the Libraries; bring a flash drive for the One Button Studio.

cards.title: Assistive Technology Room
cards.subtitle: Evans Library, first floor, Room 108F
cards.notes: Use the adaptive workstations, magnification, scanning, and text-to-speech tools; stop by the AskUs Desk if you need help locating it.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Evans room with adaptive technology and loanable devices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Assistive Technology Room in Evans Library supports students, faculty, staff, and community users with disabilities and is first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Assistive Technology Room | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; AskUs Desk staff can assist with finding the room.

cards.title: Student Veteran Study Room
cards.subtitle: Evans Library, second floor, Room 252C
cards.notes: Eligible student veterans can arrange swipe access, then use the collaborative table, soft seating, computers, and whiteboard wall for coursework.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated Evans Library study room for student veterans.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Veteran Study Room in Evans Library is a dedicated space with a collaborative table, soft seating, OAL computers, and a whiteboard wall.
cards.source_title: Student Veteran Study Room | Texas A&M University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to student veterans whose student ID has been coded for swipe-card entry.
